exact_statement: The A058 v1 anchored transfer remains valid at its private-bit/disjoint-shared-block hypotheses. When the first two private bits are identified, coefficient pairs v_T(S),v_{T xor {1,2}}(S) merge coherently. With ell=v^2, Q=v^2+v_partner^2, P=(v+v_partner)^2, delta=P-Q, the exact bit ledger is H(P)=H(old)-H_ell(T|Y)-D(P||Q)-sum_Y delta(Y)log2 Q(Y), both laws normalized, 0<=D<=1 and 0<=H_ell(T|Y)<=1. Influence change is sum_Y delta(Y)(|phi(T)|+|S|)-2Pr_ell({1,2} subset T). No finite C bounds the signed cross-surprisal, or positive coherent entropy increment, by shared-anchor influence in all such Boolean compositions: quadratic bent cores give R=k, Delta H=k-2, I_anchor=1 and Delta I_data=k/2 for every k>=1. Nor is latent posterior<=C I_anchor: an off-diagonal exceptional outer with identical literal children gives posterior=1 and I_anchor=0. The exact deficit transport retains both credits and the influence change; its universal sign/payment remains open. Restricted physical-tree replacement: for a fresh fair-selector mux of G(S,X)=epsilon(X)chi_{A(X)}(S) and H(S,Y)=eta(Y)chi_{B(Y)}(S), arbitrary finite shared S and disjoint private X,Y, the exact coherent collision potential R satisfies H(F)=(H(G)+H(H))/2+R, 0<=R<=(4+2/ln2)I_data(F). At each actual data query the signed erasure correction D_i relative to half the two core erasures obeys |D_i|<=4 Inf_i(F), with factor 2 at private queries. Every adaptive data prefix has |R_root-E R_leaf|<=(4+2/ln2)(I(F_root)-E I(F_leaf)). An optional selector suffix spends the remaining data reserve; both inherited terminal core entropies remain explicit. The indexed-parity hypothesis is equivalent to hereditary l1<=1 conditional-private-mean profiles. General hereditary norm repair: if every private-fixed shared slice of both cores has Fourier l1 norm <=L>=1, then the physical-query correction obeys |D_private|<=2L Inf(F), |D_shared|<=min(1,4L Inf(F)); every adaptive data prefix has |R_root-E R_leaf|<=(4L+2/ln2) consumed physical influence, and the terminal selector spends only the remaining data reserve. Both inherited core entropies are retained. All two-shared-bit Boolean slices satisfy L=2, giving K<11 for arbitrary data prefixes; arbitrary-width privately indexed signed shared-subcube-switch slices satisfy L=3, giving K<15, with no derivative-gap policy. A root-only profile norm bound cannot be frozen through arbitrary private exposure: for even k, activating the bent branch of the A078 spike/bent pair on k/2 private controls gives both root mean norms <2 but a reached rare query with D/Inf>=k-4. This refutes only a frozen-root pointwise price, not a cumulative tree budget or FEI.

exact_statement: On independent uniform physical bits, threshold f_(n,r)=2*1_{|b|>=r}-1 has coefficient a_k=2^-n sum_(j=0..k,l=0..n-k)(2*1_{j+l>=r}-1)(-1)^j binom(k,j)binom(n-k,l), with multiplicity binom(n,k), and I=n*2^-(n-1)*binom(n-1,r-1) for 1<=r<=n (zero for constant endpoints). For disjoint t tribes of width w, q=2^-w,b=1-q,a=b^t, f=1-2 prod(1-A_j), the empty coefficient is 1-2a and a nonempty set meeting k tribes has coefficient -2*(-q)^k*b^(t-k), with multiplicity binom(t,k)*(2^w-1)^k. I=2twq*b^(t-1) and H=phi((1-2a)^2)+8wtqa-8t(ba-a^2)log2(b)-8(a-a^2). Balanced disjoint substitution has H(F)=H(g)+sum_i Inf_i(g)H(f_i), I(F)=sum_i Inf_i(g)I(f_i). Recursive majority3 depth ell has I=(3/2)^ell, H=4*((3/2)^ell-1), and degree PGF R_ell=(3/4)R_(ell-1)+(1/4)R_(ell-1)^3, R_0=z. Stage-2 extension: For every even m>=2, alpha=binom(m,m/2)/2^m, and every Boolean core G on disjoint uniform inputs (not necessarily balanced), F=Maj_(m+1)(x_1,...,x_m,G(y))=g(x)+c(x)G(y), where g=sign(sum x), g=0 on ties, c=1_{sum x=0}. The g and c Fourier supports have odd and even x-cardinality. Fhat(X,Y)=ghat(X)1_{Y=empty}+chat(X)Ghat(Y); H(F)=H(Maj_(m+1))+alpha H(G), I(F)=alpha(m+I(G)), and at every data split (B_i,M_i,Q_i,JS_i)(F)=alpha*(B_i,M_i,Q_i,JS_i)(G). If G is balanced, all x erasures vanish and B(F)=alpha B(G). For m=2, H=2+H(G)/2,I=1+I(G)/2,B(F)=B(G)/2+(1+mu^2)h2(mu^2/(1+mu^2)),mu=E G, and both children at every data split have kappa=3/4. For m=2 tribes q=2^-w,b=1-q,beta=2q*b^(t-1), the exact y-first Lambda is (beta/2)sum_(j=0..t-1,u=1..w)log2(1+(3/4)*2^(u-1)*b^-(t-j-1)); symmetric-threshold stopping subtracts (beta/2)log2(7/4), has E Ileaf=1+beta/2 and E Hleaf=2. Stage-3 extension: Let W_+=(1+x)/2+(1-x)G/2 and W_-=-(1-x)/2+(1+x)G/2 for any Boolean core G on disjoint uniform inputs. With mu=E G,a=Ghat({i}),d=Inf_i(G),Phi(p,q)=(p+q)h2(q/(p+q)), the exact data erasure is B_i(W_+)=B_i(W_-)=B_i(G)/2+D(mu,a), where D=[Phi((1+mu)^2,a^2)+Phi((1-mu)^2,a^2)]/4-Phi(mu^2,a^2)/2. It satisfies -|mu a|<=D<=|a|<=d; the upper coefficient 1 is sharp at G=y_i. Inf_i(W)=d/2. H(W)=H(G)/2+R(mu), with R=1-mu^2+phi((1+mu)^2/4)+phi((1-mu)^2/4)-phi(mu^2)/2. B_x(W)=Phi((1+mu)^2,(1-mu)^2)/4+(1-mu^2)/2<=1-mu^2<=4Inf_x(W). Stage-4 extension: For arbitrary Boolean branches G,H on one common uniform data cube and fresh-selector F=(G+H)/2+z(G-H)/2, every data query has B_i(F)=sum_T[Phi((g_T+h_T)^2,(g_(T+i)+h_(T+i))^2)+Phi((g_T-h_T)^2,(g_(T+i)-h_(T+i))^2)]/4 and Inf_i(F)=[Inf_i(G)+Inf_i(H)]/2. Writing D_i=B_i(F)-[B_i(G)+B_i(H)]/2, |D_i|<=1. If every restriction of H has each relevant influence >=eta>0, a policy querying H-relevant coordinates while H is nonconstant has |D_i|<=Inf_i(H)/eta and B_i(F)<=2Inf_i(F)/eta. After H is constant, |D_i|<=Inf_i(G). For H=(-1)^P with F2 algebraic degree <=d>=1, eta=2^(1-d); in particular every quadratic H has eta=1/2. All shared Fourier rows and the exact leaf potential R=H(F)-[H(G)+H(H)]/2 are retained.

exact_statement: Fix lambda>0, q=2^-w,t=floor(lambda/q),a=(1-q)^t and use the preceding uniform tribes. H=8lambda*exp(-lambda)*w+O_lambda(1), I=2lambda*exp(-lambda)*w+O_lambda(wq), hence H/I->4. For A one entire tribe, c=1-4a+4a^2/(1-q),u=4qa^2/((1-q)c), M_A=c*h2(u)+(1-c)*h2(q)+4qa*log2(2^w-1), I_A=2wq*(1-q)^(t-1), L_A=H_(w,t)-(1-q)H_(w,t-1), J_A=L_A-M_A and Delta_A=0. If lambda!=ln2, M_A/I_A->4,J_A/I_A->0,L_A/I_A->4. If lambda=ln2, M_A/I_A->3,J_A/I_A->1,L_A/I_A->4. Thus universal M_A<=K I_A or L_A<=K I_A requires K>=4. Additionally the marginal code M=sum_i h2(Inf_i) obeys M/I=w-1+(lambda+1)log2(e)+O_lambda(q), whereas H(|S|)=O_lambda(log w) and H(S||S|)/I->4. Recursive majority3 gives M/I=ell+log2(e)+O(2^-ell), H(|S|)=O(ell), H/I->4 and H/(I-Var)=4 for ell>=1. These refute only a dimension-free payment of the independent-marginal code and any universal H<=C[H(|S|)+Var], not FEI or the B09 helper. Stage-2 extension: For even w>=16,t=2^w,G=uniform disjoint tribes(w,t),F=Maj3(x1,x2,G), and any fixed interleaving of the two x queries with the contiguous block-by-block y order, both constant-only and symmetric-threshold stopping trees satisfy Lambda_T/I(F)>=w/64, including after exact-zero-erasure skipping. The y-first tree has Lambda_T/I(F)=w/2+O(1), also with the same symmetric leaf certificate. At the identical trees, B_T+9 E Ileaf<=14 I(F), because H(G)<=5 I(G) and H(F)<=5 I(F). The lower bound counts actual queried influence; no physical spectator tensor is present since F is monotone and all inputs are relevant. These refute only a universal scalar Lambda payment for the specified schedules/leaf class, not arbitrary adaptive y orders, LOG_ALLOCATION local bound, C019 or FEI. Finally, for fixed even m, the supremum of B/I over central-majority compositions with arbitrary balanced cores equals the unrestricted supremum: cores G=z product_(a=1..k)h_a have H(G)=kH(h),I(G)=1+kI(h),B(G)=kB(h), giving B(F)/I(F)->B(h)/I(h) and H(F)/I(F)->H(h)/I(h). Stage-3 extension: For every finite adaptive partial physical core tree T lifted to either one-control wrapper with x unqueried, B_T(W)=B_T(G)/2+D_T, |D_T|<=Pi_I(G)=I(G)-E I(G_leaf), and Pi_I(W)=Pi_I(G)/2. The terminal entropy is exactly E H(W_leaf)=E H(G_leaf)/2+E R(mu_leaf). Querying x at every leaf adds erasure at most 4Inf_x(W_root), giving B_(T;x)(W)<=B_T(G)/2+Pi_I(G)+4Inf_x(W_root). The signed correction may be negative: the three-bit point core G=+1 only at (+++) gives D(-3/4,1/4)<0 by a rational interval certificate. These results pay the shifted-empty-row correction alone; inherited core erasure and arbitrary terminal entropy remain unpriced. No conclusion of full FEI or a universal shared-coordinate ownership rule is claimed. Stage-4 extension: Under the derivative-gap policy, any adaptive partial data prefix T satisfies B_T(F)=[B_T(G)+B_T(H)]/2+sum wD_i and sum w|D_i|<=P_H/eta+P_G0. Here P_H=I(H)-E I(H_leaf) is spent only on H-relevant queries and P_G0 is G influence spent after H becomes constant; P_G0=I(G)-E I(G_leaf)-P_G1, where P_G1 is G influence already spent in the first phase. Thus one exclusive source reserve is used without recharging terminal cores. For every even k>=2 A078 bent/spike fixture G=1-2*1{s=0,x=0}, H=(-1)^sum paired shared-bit products, the complete policy has B_i(F)<=4Inf_i(F) in the H phase and <=5Inf_i(F) in the point-core suffix, with zero-entropy terminal character/constant. Therefore its actual B_T and retained Q_T are <=5I(F). This is a hereditary paid data-only policy, not an improvement of the existing H(F)<4I(F) class bound. Inherited arbitrary-core erasure/terminal entropy and uniform derivative-gap removal remain unpaid.
